golden_visa.plate_blurb: For pricing, availability, viewings and Golden-Visa guidance on any project, get in touch. We coordinate directly with all developers.
golden_visa.plate_line2: WhatsApp, Telegram or email — we reply the same day.

property_management.plate_blurb: For viewings, leasing, rent collection, maintenance and reporting, get in touch. One team looks after your Athens property end to end.
property_management.plate_line2: WhatsApp, Telegram or email — we reply the same day.

values.title: Transparency by default
values.text: Every fee, every report, every deposit movement is visible. No hidden letting fees, no surprises — you only pay when the rent is actually collected.

values.title: One team, end to end
values.text: Viewings, lease, rent, maintenance and reporting — handled by the same people and logged on the platform, so nothing falls through the cracks.

values.title: For local & international clients
values.text: We serve tenants and landlords alike, whether they're in Athens or abroad. Language is never a barrier — our clients speak many, and so do we.

comparison.title: Better than a private landlord.
us: Fast move-in — every step is digital
All communication logged with timestamps, ready if a dispute arises
One team for viewings, lease & repairs
Clear rules for tenants & owners, managed by mamaXO
them: No record of liabilities during the tenancy

property_management.team_heading: Real people in Athens, on your side.

difference.title: Local expertise
difference.text: In-country expertise across the whole Golden-Visa process and the Greek property market.

difference.title: Remote & simple
difference.text: Built for international clients running the entire process from abroad.

difference.title: Management after purchase
difference.text: Ongoing on-the-ground support to manage your Greek property once you own it.

difference.title: End-to-end support
difference.text: One structured process — from the first consultation to residence approval.

services_after_purchase.title: Residency & documents
services_after_purchase.text: We monitor your paperwork and renew your residence permit on time — your Golden Visa stays valid without you lifting a finger.

services_after_purchase.title: Accounting support
services_after_purchase.text: Filing tax declarations, paying property taxes and handling every local obligation on your behalf.

services_after_purchase.title: Legal & notary services
services_after_purchase.text: Property transactions, inheritance and full remote legal representation — handled by our partners in Greece.

services_after_purchase.title: Property management
services_after_purchase.text: We find and settle tenants, transfer rent to you, maintain the property and keep it insured — fully hands-off.

brand_colors._note: Minimal on purpose, mirroring the published reports: ONE orange, ONE ink, three surfaces, three accents. Lighter text = the same ink at lower opacity (rgba(43,43,45,.56)), not a separate grey.

typography.preview_fallback: Poppins (display) / Lato (text) — used only when Archivo/Inter can't load

logo.rules: Three lockups: (1) logo-full.png — wordmark for light backgrounds (default, since documents are cream). (2) logo-mark.png — orange badge/circle (white mXO) for the contact page mark, avatars, small spots. (3) logo-full-ondark.png — white 'mama' wordmark, only if a rare dark detail needs it. Never recolor, stretch, or add effects. Keep clear space ≈ height of the 'o'.

languages._note: The system is multilingual. A document is produced in ONE chosen language; content is authored in that language and the matching back-matter / disclaimer strings are pulled from this file.

disclaimers.en: General information, not legal or tax advice. Figures and legal wording must be checked against official sources on the date of publication.
disclaimers.ru: Общая информация, не юридическая/налоговая консультация. Цифры и правовые формулировки сверять с официальными источниками на дату публикации.
disclaimers.tr: Genel bilgi niteliğindedir; hukuki veya vergi danışmanlığı değildir. Rakamlar ve yasal ifadeler yayın tarihinde resmi kaynaklardan doğrulanmalıdır.
disclaimers.ai_media: Any image, audio or video generated or altered by AI must be disclosed as AI-generated (EU AI Act, Art. 50, from 2 Aug 2026). Real Adobe Stock photos and human-edited text do not require this label.

canonical_facts.note: Always state figures as of publication date; verify against official sources.
